fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.help: If false, any query using this reservation will use idle slots from other reservations within the same admin project.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: The geographic location where the transfer config should reside.

fields.label: Reservation Group

fields.label: Slot Capacity
fields.help: Minimum slots available to this reservation.
